evaluation_notes: LinkedIn postings are typically full-time or contract roles, not freelance gigs.
Company size can indicate culture fit — startups may offer more ownership, large corps more stability.
LinkedIn roles rarely include explicit budgets — evaluate based on role level and company profile.
Remote availability should be confirmed in the job description; LinkedIn 'Remote' filter can be inconsistent.
LinkedIn-specific red flags: 'game developer' used as a catch-all for non-Unity stacks, senior-only roles with no flexibility, on-site requirements mismatched with remote preference.
